pageSubtitle: A collection of milestones, achievements, awards, certifications, community involvement, and memorable experiences that tell the story beyond my code.

items.title: Backend Developer at Next Coach
items.description: Next Coach is an online learning platform for 1-on-1 mentorship, consultations, live classes and webinars with verified industry experts. As a part-time backend developer, I built server-side features and APIs with Next.js and TypeScript, and designed the PostgreSQL data model with Prisma ORM.

items.title: Foundational C# with Microsoft
items.description: Microsoft's Foundational C# certification, covering C# syntax, types, control flow, methods, error handling and debugging.

items.title: C# Class Development
items.description: Object-oriented programming in C#: classes, properties, constructors, inheritance, interfaces and encapsulation. I use these concepts every day when building ASP.NET services.

items.title: Introduction to Web Development with HTML, CSS, JavaScript
items.description: The core web technologies behind the Razor views, JavaScript components and AngularJS frontends I connect my backend APIs to.

items.title: BSc. CSIT
items.description: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Information Technology from Tribhuvan University.

items.title: Higher Secondary School
items.description: Higher secondary education under the National Examination Board (NEB).

items.title: Awarded As a Rising Developer
items.description: I was awarded the Rising Developer Award during Dynamic Technosoft's 16th Anniversary, a milestone that I am truly proud of. Receiving this award just 10 months after joining reflected the impact of my contributions to the Flutter team, my dedication, and the trust I earned early in my journey. This achievement motivates me to keep building meaningful products, take ownership, and create lasting value through my work.
